decisions.reason: As a core desk-system product that remained actively presented after launch, it likely performs near the firm's aspiration level and merits continued support.
A chair family fits the firm's established furniture capabilities and portfolio logic, so with no clear sign of failure management would keep it under boundedly rational evaluation.
Floor cushions made from carpets look more peripheral to the core business, and if results are only uncertain or below aspiration the firm would reallocate resources to stronger furniture lines.
The sofa received stronger dedicated promotion in 2019, suggesting strategic commitment, and an older firm with some slack would likely give this adjacent product more time.
A high standing table is close to the firm's main product domain and likely benefits from shared sales channels, so it would be retained unless performance clearly fell below aspiration.
A rug collection is the most accessory-like and easiest to cut if it underperforms, making it a likely target for problemistic search and resource redeployment.
